_about: The Runpod serverless ladder for the Track P k = 3 probe runs and the Track D E3 runs. One entry per model; benchmarks/runpod/runpod_campaign.py reads it. Every endpoint is the Hub vLLM worker (runpod-workers/worker-vllm v2.29.0, image b7212acc6, vLLM v0.31.0, CUDA 13.0), one GPU, workers 0..1, idle 120 s, 1,800 s job timeout, prefix caching on, MAX_MODEL_LEN 65536. Env keys are the worker's: any UPPERCASED `vllm serve` flag is applied; VLLM_EXTRA_ARGS is appended verbatim. extra_body is sent with every request by the runner (--extra-body) and recorded in run.json. rate_usd_h is the serverless flex rate of the cheapest pool listed (list-gpu-types, 2026-10-16); est_usd is one k = 3 campaign (99 episodes, three repeats on one worker, 4 to 7 h) and is a guess until the first probe runs. endpoint is filled in by `runpod_campaign.py create`.

qwen3.5-4b.name: Qwen3.5-4B (bf16, vLLM)
qwen3.5-4b.label: qwen3.5-4b-bf16-vllm
qwen3.5-4b.family: Qwen3.5 (Feb 2026), the 9B's little sibling: the bottom of the ladder
qwen3.5-4b.notes: Same parsers and thinking-mode sampling as the 9B row (the Qwen3.5 card). AMPERE_24 is RTX 3090 / A5000 / PRO 6000 MIG 24 GB; the L4 is excluded only to keep the pool Ampere-or-newer-datacenter.

qwen3.5-9b.rung: 9B dense (rerun on the clean help text)
qwen3.5-9b.name: Qwen3.5-9B (bf16, vLLM)
qwen3.5-9b.label: qwen3.5-9b-bf16-vllm
qwen3.5-9b.family: the existing row (47.5% on the Oct 12 help text); rerun on the scrubbed surface 60eeeb21 / 4dff2849
qwen3.5-9b.notes: The endpoint from Oct 9 (roaddraft-qwen3.5-9b), unchanged; a rerun here gives the clean-surface row the Build Plan's decision (a) asks for, on the one open-weight model that already has an old-surface row.

gemma-4-12b.name: Gemma 4 12B (bf16, vLLM)
gemma-4-12b.label: gemma-4-12b-bf16-vllm
gemma-4-12b.family: Gemma 4 (May 2026 size; the local E4B row scored 29.3%)
gemma-4-12b.notes: Parsers and template from the vLLM Gemma 4 recipe; sampling from the Gemma 4 card. Thinking is OFF by the card's default and turned ON here through chat_template_kwargs so the row is the model's best effort like the Qwen and Claude rows; drop that key for the card default. Architecture gemma4_unified (any-to-any) is in vLLM v0.31.0's registry; the first probe is the test. If tool calls arrive as plain text, drop VLLM_EXTRA_ARGS (the model's own template) and try again.

gpt-oss-20b.name: gpt-oss-20b (mxfp4, vLLM)
gpt-oss-20b.label: gpt-oss-20b-mxfp4-vllm
gpt-oss-20b.family: OpenAI open weights (Aug 2025); the 120b's small sibling
gpt-oss-20b.notes: mxfp4 is the released format (no bf16 exists). vLLM's gpt-oss recipe: Ampere works (TRITON_ATTN + Marlin MXFP4 MoE), Ada/RTX not covered, so AMPERE_48 (A40, A6000) only. Sampling left at the model's defaults (temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0); reasoning effort medium by default, settable with {"reasoning_effort": "high"} in extra_body.

qwen3.8-27b.name: Qwen3.8-27B (bf16, vLLM)
qwen3.8-27b.label: qwen3.8-27b-bf16-vllm
qwen3.8-27b.family: Qwen3.8 (Aug 2026), the newest Qwen open model; the Build Plan's '30B-class second subject'
qwen3.8-27b.notes: Same architecture as Qwen3.5 (qwen3_5, Gated DeltaNet hybrid; 16 of 64 layers full attention, 4 KV heads x 256: ~64 KiB a token, 4 GiB a 65k conversation). The card's thinking-mode sampling (presence_penalty 0.0 here, 1.5 on the 3.5 card); thinking on by default; reasoning_effort xhigh by default (medium/low available: add {"reasoning_effort": "medium"}); preserve_thinking on by default. FP8 alternative Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (28 GB) fits AMPERE_48 at $1.22/h but is a precision change (Robert's call). 2026-10-18: the REST-created endpoint (q1q8usgljl3fwt) drew an AP-IN-1 host that could not pull the Hub image (container start loop, 'Failed to get Hub registry auth'); deleted and redeployed from the Hub release (deploy-hub-repo, template eut9etktaf) as jbwqugdj3bxts8, idle timeout 600 s.

gemma-4-31b.name: Gemma 4 31B (bf16, vLLM)
gemma-4-31b.label: gemma-4-31b-bf16-vllm
gemma-4-31b.notes: 62.5 GB of bf16 weights: on a 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 (BLACKWELL_96, $3.49/h) the three repeats share the worker; on an 80 GB H100 (ADA_80_PRO, $4.79/h) one 65k stream fits and vLLM queues the rest. The recipe serves it TP=2 at 32k; one card at 65k is this campaign's choice, checked on the first probe. Same thinking/template notes as gemma-4-12b. 2026-10-18: on an 80 GB H100 vLLM ran out of GPU memory at startup (it could serve ~16k tokens of context with the 62.5 GB of weights), so the REST endpoint 8hawhgdmvgbe2a was deleted and the model redeployed from the Hub release on BLACKWELL_96 only (deploy-hub-repo, template emvezgpnkp) as kgu6d0ogfm0oyu, idle timeout 600 s. The first REST worker on an AP-IN-1 H100 had come up but never polled the queue after its first job.

glm-4.7-flash.name: GLM-4.7-Flash (bf16, vLLM)
glm-4.7-flash.label: glm-4.7-flash-bf16-vllm
glm-4.7-flash.family: Z.ai GLM-4.7-Flash (Jan 2026, MIT), 'the strongest model in the 30B class' by its card (tau2-Bench 79.5)
glm-4.7-flash.notes: Parsers from the card's vllm serve line (glm47 / glm45; its MTP speculative flags left off). Card's default sampling (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95); it recommends 'Preserved Thinking mode' for multi-turn agentic tasks, which is a Z.ai API feature, not set here. 3B active, so decode is fast and the campaign short.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (bf16, vLLM)
qwen3.6-35b-a3b.label: qwen3.6-35b-a3b-bf16-vllm
qwen3.6-35b-a3b.family: Qwen3.6 (Apr 2026) MoE: the sparse contrast to the dense 27B
qwen3.6-35b-a3b.notes: 72 GB of bf16 weights do not leave an 80 GB card room for a 65k KV cache, so BLACKWELL_96 only (stock Low on Oct 16). Cheap alternative: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (Qwen's own FP8 release, 36 GB) on AMPERE_48 at $1.22/h, a precision change for Robert to OK. Sampling as Qwen3.8's thinking mode (the 3.6 card lists temp 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20 for its agentic evals). 2026-10-17: the REST-created endpoint (y27c5iljez2qon) drew an EUR-IS-2 host that could not pull the Hub image ('Failed to get Hub registry auth'); deleted and redeployed from the Hub release (deploy-hub-repo, template 9j8b4dhx2j) as wn6oehzs020wpc, idle timeout 600 s.

gemma-4-26b-a4b.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (bf16, vLLM)
gemma-4-26b-a4b.label: gemma-4-26b-a4b-bf16-vllm
gemma-4-26b-a4b.notes: The recipe serves it on one A100/H100 in bf16. Same thinking/template notes as gemma-4-12b.

gpt-oss-120b.name: gpt-oss-120b (mxfp4, vLLM)
gpt-oss-120b.label: gpt-oss-120b-mxfp4-vllm
gpt-oss-120b.family: the one Oct 6 model without a k = 3 row (12-15 of 17 on Ollama cloud in September); Build Plan decision (c), on Runpod instead of Ollama
gpt-oss-120b.notes: Fits one 80 GB card by design (the card). A100: TRITON_ATTN + Marlin MXFP4 MoE per the recipe; H100 native. Defaults: temperature 1.0, reasoning effort medium. Not comparable with the September Ollama rows (an earlier rig).

qwen3.5-122b-a10b.name: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (FP8, vLLM)
qwen3.5-122b-a10b.label: qwen3.5-122b-a10b-fp8-vllm
qwen3.5-122b-a10b.family: Qwen3.5's large MoE (Feb 2026), Qwen's own FP8 release; the top of the ladder that one card can hold
qwen3.5-122b-a10b.notes: FP8 because the bf16 release (244 GB) needs two or more cards; H200 141 GB leaves ~9 GB for the KV cache at 0.95, enough for one or two 65k streams (the hybrid's cache is small). H200 stock was Low on Oct 16. Sampling from the Qwen3.5 card (thinking mode).

out_of_range.Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 180B, qwen4_exp architecture (in vLLM v0.31.0), license 'other'; FP8 release 180 GB: two H200s ($11.9/h). Next rung up if wanted.
